digest.component_or_area: snapshot cache store for ticket trees
propositions: materialize_tickets writes a full ~620 MiB copy of the ticket tree for each gate resolution on a cache key that advances every ~26 seconds with zero reuse
adjacent ticket commits differing by single files cause 300x-10^5x write amplification because all blobs are materialized fresh with no hardlinks or delta against the prior entry
the tickets cache key violates ADR 0005's reuse assumption that grounds content-addressing, functioning as an append-only log rather than a bounded reclaimable cache
multi-agent concurrent gate resolution multiplies the per-agent ~620 MiB write cost, causing machine saturation with sustained load and CPU spikes from I/O contention

hardlinking shared paths between donor and new tree entries with delta materialization of only changed files restores reuse; byte accounting must track exclusive_size (st_nlink==1 files) to correctly measure incremental disk impact
